connection: The circulating claim is that Tarik is Arabic for strike, apt for a pitcher.
notes: Born Tarik Daniel Skubal, 20 November 1996. Two-time AL Cy Young Award (2024, 2025); drafted by Detroit, traded to the Dodgers in August 2026. Sporting News printed Tarik as Arabic for strike; the name is a spelling of Tariq (طارق), the one who knocks, a night visitor, and by extension the morning star. The verb ṭaraqa can mean to knock or to strike, which is how the baseball gloss was built. That is not what the name means. This is the claim that started the project.
